covenants.text: The Borrower shall not permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of the Borrower (commencing with the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2017) to be greater than 3.50 to 1.00 (the " Maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio "), except as permitted below.

The Borrower shall not permit the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of the Borrower, commencing with the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2017, to be less than 2.50 to 1.00.
Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the end of any period of four fiscal quarters of the Borrower to be greater than 3.00 to 1.00.
